Website Redesign ProjectMessage Board Bookmark
Pulling the launch in by two weeks

Chad Neidt on Apr 29 • 📢 Announcement • Notified 5 people

Quick but important update on timing. After conversations with leadership and our partner
teams, we've decided to move the launch of the new website forward by two weeks. The
marketing window we'd been planning around is shifting earlier, and rather than have our
work trail it, we want it to land alongside it where it'll have real momentum.

Some of the polish we'd planned for the final stretch will need to be triaged. We'll meet as a
team this week to walk the board together and decide what's truly launch-blocking versus
what can ship in a v1.1 patch — and Geoff and I will work with each of you individually on
anything that affects your in-flight work.

What gives me confidence is just looking at what you've already shipped. The hero direction
is locked, the type stack is settled, the spacing system is documented and out the door, and
the LCP fix is well past the worst of it.

Geoff Collier, Head of Design • Apr 29

Quick logistics question, Chad: do you want design to walk into Thursday's review with a
pre-cut list of what we'd move, or would you rather we make those calls live as a group?

👍 🙏 💯

Chad Neidt, Senior Visual Storyteller • Apr 29

Pre-cut list — please. Save us all an hour. Bring two tiers if you can: things you'd cut
comfortably and things you'd cut reluctantly but could live without.

👍 🙌 💪 ❤️

Sofía Castillo Rivera, Customer Experience Specialist • Apr 29

Quick clarification before we build the cut list — when we say 'launch May 22,' is that public-
public, or is there a soft-launch / staging window with select customers before that? It
matters for how we sequence the cut list, since a soft-launch would buy us a little room.

Hey there—

Tell me if this sounds about right.

Every day you’re juggling people, projects, and expectations. There are tasks to do, discussions to have, decisions to make, files to share, deadlines to hit, relationships to manage, and work to deliver.

This all has to happen somewhere. But you’ve discovered that spreading everything across different apps, browser tabs, emails, and chats doesn’t work. You need a system.

Unfortunately, most project management systems are bloated, complicated, and confusing. And software that’s hard to use doesn’t get used.

20 years ago we were in the same boat. We needed something capable, but also straightforward, easy, and reliable. Nothing fit. So we invented Basecamp, and have been improving it ever since. In software, longevity like this isn’t luck — it’s proof it works. And in 2026 we released the all-new Basecamp 5, packing decades of experience into our best version yet.

Today, Basecamp is used across every industry, and nearly a million people, teams, companies, and non-profits worldwide rely on it daily.

Thanks for checking us out. We invite you to give Basecamp a try. And ultimately, we’d be honored to have you as a customer.

Jason Fried, jason@basecamp.com
Co-founder & CEO

Take a minute to meet some of our customers

They’re product developers, woodworkers, music industry folks, logistics pros, publishers, event planners, marketers, architects, artists, software designers, brand strategists, educators…

Remember when companies cared about service?

We still do! Staffed by incredible humans, we’re here for you 24/7/365.

Meet Eron, our Head of Technical Ops

Durable infrastructure

Rather than rent cloud hosting, we own and run our hardware across multiple data centers. We specified the hardware, configured (and sometimes invented) the software, and optimized every detail for speed and reliability. We’ve maintained an industry-leading 99.99% uptime record for years.

Meet Chase, our Head of Support

Dependable customer service

At most companies, customer service is treated as an afterthought, something to outsource, a place to cut costs. At Basecamp it’s one of our best features. Our customers consistently rave about our kind, patient, and deeply knowledgeable staff. Everyone on the team can answer any question.
